name: Null-Scattering Volumetric Path Tracing
aliases: Volumetric Path Tracing with Null Scattering
definition: A volumetric path-tracing algorithm that uses a homogeneous majorant medium with an added null-scattering term ($\sigma_n$) to sample distances along a ray. It solves the equation of transfer by treating absorption, scattering, and null-scattering as mutually exclusive events with probabilities proportional to their coefficients.
